lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Good morning, Hyunju! Are you OK?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I rode a bike for eleven kilometers. It was very good, but my whole body hurts.
lines.ko: 자전거를 11킬로미터 탔어요. 정말 좋았는데, 온몸이 아파요.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Wow, eleven kilometers! Where did you go?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I started near my home and went to Jamsil Han River Park.
lines.ko: 집 근처에서 출발해서 잠실 한강공원까지 갔어요.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Nice! How long did it take?

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Only forty minutes? Was it your first time riding that far?
lines.ko: 40분밖에 안 걸렸어요? 그렇게 멀리 탄 건 처음이에요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: No, I've ridden sixteen kilometers before.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Wow! So why does your body hurt this time?
lines.ko: 와! 그런데 이번엔 왜 몸이 아파요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Because I haven't ridden a bike for a long time.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Ah, that's why! Which part hurts the most?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: My back and legs hurt the most.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Oh no! Did you check your seat height?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I checked it before I started. I think I was too tense.
lines.ko: 출발하기 전에 확인했어요. 몸에 너무 힘이 들어갔던 것 같아요.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: I see. Will you ride to Jamsil again?
lines.ko: 그렇군요. 잠실에 또 자전거 타고 갈 거예요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I will go again before it gets too cold.
lines.ko: 네, 너무 추워지기 전에 또 갈 거예요.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Good idea! Can I join you next time?
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요! 다음엔 저도 같이 가도 돼요?

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Yay! Take a good rest, Hyunju!
